maddeler.e:
اختفوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَفَوْا (iḵtafaw) /ix.ta.faw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اُخْتُفُوا (uḵtufū) /ux.tu.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# اِخْتَفُوا (iḵtafū) /ix.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
